what: Implements, Method and the other impl facts' values hash interface_hash (facts.rs:205, 216, 220, 234, 548), with the same cycle as Signature in 00881: lane items' fact values are computed inside the body's own inference, and an interface hash reaches a body that leaks (an async fn, a const fn), possibly the one being inferred. Make them signature_hash, in the same change as 00881. Lane dbsp's new hashes (hir_ty::method_resolution::delta impl_set_hash, impl_row_hash, blanket_hash, candidate_set_hash) are not a replacement: they name each impl by impl_identity, its ImplLoc with its crate's content, so any edit anywhere in the crate changes them, where an Implements value keyed on signature hashes stays. They could give a quick check that a slice is unchanged before the walk, once impl_identity names an impl by item key.

history.note: Implements, Method, Coherence (via implements_value), Specializes, Vtable, DropCheck, Derive and the impl index entries (ImplEntry now holds SignatureHash, index::impl_signature) name items by signature_hash; domains bumped. Field, Captures, AutoTraits and a const's type still fill refs by interface hash (codegen reads Captures). Test: what_an_impls_items_leak_keeps_its_impl_facts.
